rationale: The agent executed an exchange write (exchange_delivered_order_items) but there is no evidence it confirmed the action with the user beforehand, as required by policy. Authentication steps are unclear beyond an email-based lookup, and there is no explicit confirmation of payment method selection or order-changing consent. The final message provides no concrete post-exchange details (e.g., exchange confirmation, return instructions, costs/refunds, timeline). These gaps violate the policy’s requirements to authenticate, confirm before any order change, and provide correct final information.
